review.evidence: Mayrina is Connor Vinderblad's adult widow in the Save Mayrina quest. The quest root has HAG_Mayrina stats. Its only child, the hag's adult Mayrina disguise, explicitly declares its own visual.

This is the hag's disguise as the adult widow Mayrina. Its parent is the reviewed QUEST_HAG_Mayrina and its stats are HAG_Mayrina_Polymorph. Both appearances use the same body to preserve the disguise.
Quenora Grisly is the adult pirate captain at the Blushing Mermaid. This named Lower City root and its character visual identify QuenoraGrizly and its stats are LOW_QuenoraGrizly.

This is the adult pact-holder Mizora in the human disguise used in Wyll's story. The named character visual and root both identify Wyll_Cambion_HumanForm. This approval is specific to this human disguise.
Kerri Evenfield is Oskar Fevras's deceased adult former partner. This Lower City quest root is her named spirit appearance in Free the Artist, with LOW_OskarsBeloved_Spirit stats.
Dalyria was a physician before Cazador made her a vampire spawn. Both this alternate root and its visual identify the adult Dalyria by name. Its approval is specific to that appearance.
This cinematic adult Minthara root directly inherits the reviewed normal gameplay root of the drow commander. Her original catalog entries and this appearance use the same identity seed.
The explicit hoodless appearance of the same adult commander Minthara has GOB_DrowCommander stats and equipment. Its named visual and root identify her.
The original adult Minthara nude appearance has GOB_DrowCommander stats and a character visual named TEMP_Minthara_Naked. Its body matches her other appearances.
Isobel Thorm is an adult cleric of Selune and Dame Aylin's partner. This Dark Urge cinematic root explicitly points to the named S_GLO_Isobel visual and covers that appearance.
Belynne Stelmane was an adult duke of Baldur's Gate. This specific Emperor cinematic depicts Duke Stelmane as the city's officeholder and has its own named visual.
Mystra is the adult goddess of magic in Gale's story. The exact cinematic root and character visual are named CINE_Mystra and cover her depicted adult appearance.
Nym Orlith is the adult drow courtesan working at Sharess' Caress. This is her named local sister appearance and uses WYR_DapperDrow_Sister stats.
This cinematic appearance of the adult courtesan Nym Orlith uses WYR_DapperDrow_Sister stats and a visual explicitly named UNI_WYR_DapperDrow_Sister_Naked.
This hooded look belongs to the adult Counsellor Florrick, advisor to Grand Duke Ravengard. The root inherits her S_GLO_Desire template and has GLO_CounsellorFlorrick stats.
This bruised look belongs to the adult Counsellor Florrick, advisor to Grand Duke Ravengard. The root inherits her S_GLO_Desire template and has GLO_CounsellorFlorrick stats.
This execution appearance belongs to the adult Counsellor Florrick, advisor to Grand Duke Ravengard. It inherits her S_GLO_Desire root and has GLO_CounsellorFlorrick stats.
Alfira is the adult tiefling bard and Lakrissa's partner. This grove cinematic has Tiefling_Bard stats and explicitly references her S_DEN_BrokenBard visual.
Lae'zel is the adult gith warrior already reviewed in the original companion catalog. This separate ORIGIN_INTRO_Laezel root has its own explicitly named visual.
This is the named attack-quest appearance depicting the adult githyanki lich queen Vlaakith. Both the root and its explicit visual identify TWN_VlaakithAttack_VlaakithForm.
